items.title: ‘I’m not ready to go to jail’: co-founder of Egypt’s last independent media outlet faces prison
items.summary: Mada Masr, the news site co-founded by Lina Attalah just before the 2013 military coup, is fighting for its life after being shut down, but its journalists have not given up hope Facing a year in prison for running Egypt’s leading independent news outlet Mada…
